title: Studio 列表视图：对象没有默认视图时不要去读 <object>.default 的分层（每个新对象都报一次 404）
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

① product defect · Source: maintainer (Warren), 2026-11-23, UI review thread.
- 14:23Z 「还有哪些元数据可能会有问题？同时全面的测试 studio的各项功能」
- 15:09Z 「用fable 评审一下 studio的问题，提出修改方案」
- 15:23Z, decision card 「Studio 评审的 9 张卡，按 fable 方案立卡吗？」 → **「9 张全立」**

Evidence:
- Fable code review on main 9e0c0c23: project file `ui-review-2026-11-23/fable-studio-review.md`.
- Browser screenshots: `ui-review-2026-11-23/round2/`.
- Round-2 report: https://claude.ai/artifact/X5ukNAgphAq5vDpDAT6SAD

Paths are relative to `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/` unless they start with `ui/` or `packages/`. `SDS` = `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. `zh` = `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts`. Line numbers are on 9e0c0c23.

## What (review §B, the 404; confirmed from code)
- With no view flagged as default, the list-view buffer falls back to the made-up id `<object>.default` (`studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.tsx:186–187`). Having no draft, it reads that id's published layer (`ObjectListViewInspector.tsx:718–724`).
- No such view exists, so the server answers 404 on `/meta/view/<object>.default/layers`.
- The client turns that into an empty result (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts:1772–1774`). Nothing breaks, but the browser logs the failed request.
- The guard that used to skip this read covers draft-only objects (objectui#12508). Since #36511, a new object is published at once, so the guard no longer applies.

## Expected
Skip the layered read when the id is the fallback, that is, when the object's merged `listViews` holds no view under it. The buffer already knows this (`ObjectListViewInspector.tsx:556–558`). Check the other callers of the layered read for the same fallback.

## Acceptance
A test pins that no layered read is sent for the fallback id.

Grading: `area:ux` · Bug · no effect on what the user sees · developers only ⇒ p3. It is batched with the area's close-out, not queued ahead of p2. Effort S. Evidence: read (review §B).

Dedupe: none open on this request.
